# email_service

> MCP & REST server (Rust) that lets AI agents and backend apps send email through Resend. Exposes three MCP tools — list_senders, send_email, get_email_status — plus direct HTTP REST endpoints (`POST /send`, `GET /senders`). Stateless: no database. Senders are configured in a JSON file, never hardcoded.

Key facts for agents:
- Install: cargo build --release; register the binary as an MCP server with env RESEND_API_KEY and SENDERS_FILE.
- Transports: stdio (default, local agent spawns the binary) or HTTP when MCP_HTTP_ADDR is set. HTTP mode serves MCP at `/mcp` and direct JSON REST at `POST /send` and `GET /senders` (all protected by `Authorization: Bearer <MCP_AUTH_TOKEN>`), plus public `/healthz`. VPS deploy: ./deploy.sh (pm2).
- senders.json format: [{"id": "me", "email": "you@yourdomain.com", "display_name": "Your Name"}]; ids are lowercase + hyphens, emails must use Resend-verified domains.
- send_email / `POST /send` requires `from`, `to` (string or string[]), `subject`, and `text` or `html`; max 50 recipients, 20 sends/minute rate limit.
- get_email_status takes the Resend email id and returns its JSON including last_event.
- Validation rejects malformed addresses, CR/LF in subjects, and non-allowlisted senders before any network call.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): full setup, configuration reference, REST API & MCP tools reference, security model, FAQ
- [senders.example.json](senders.example.json): sender registry template
- [.env.example](.env.example): environment variable reference

## Source

- [src/main.rs](src/main.rs): entry point, env loading, stdio/HTTP mode selection
- [src/http.rs](src/http.rs): HTTP server with bearer auth (`/mcp`, `POST /send`, `GET /senders`) and `/healthz`
- [src/server.rs](src/server.rs): MCP tool definitions and shared `send_direct` logic
- [src/senders.rs](src/senders.rs): sender registry loading and validation
- [src/validation.rs](src/validation.rs): email/subject/body/id validation rules
- [src/resend.rs](src/resend.rs): Resend API client (HTTPS-only, timeouts)
- [src/ratelimit.rs](src/ratelimit.rs): fixed-window send rate limiter
- [tests/e2e.rs](tests/e2e.rs): end-to-end tests over stdio with a mock Resend API
- [tests/e2e_http.rs](tests/e2e_http.rs): end-to-end tests over streamable HTTP and direct REST (`POST /send`) including auth
- [deploy.sh](deploy.sh): VPS deployment script (build + pm2)
- [ecosystem.config.cjs](ecosystem.config.cjs): pm2 process definition
